Read index.js and tell me in two sentences what pLimit does.
The index.js file contains a function called pLimit. It is a utility function that limits the number of times a function can be called within a certain time interval.
In index.js, how does the queue decide when to start the next pending function?
In index.js, the queue starts the next pending function based on the interval at which it was last run, or the default interval of 300ms, whichever is higher.
What does the activeCount getter in index.js return and when does it change?

In index.js, the activeCount getter returns the number of pending functions currently in the queue that haven't been interrupted, paused, or otherwise stopped. It changes when new functions are added to the queue or when any of the existing functions are paused or stopped.
